title: Say It in Your Own Words: Paraphrasing and Summarizing
objective: Students transform source sentences into clear original English.
outcomes: Use reporting verbs and citation phrases.
activity: Paraphrase workshop: rewrite three biology sentences and compare with a partner for accuracy.
example: Original: “Light intensity significantly affected seedling biomass.” Paraphrase: “Seedling biomass changed significantly when light intensity changed.”

classroom.title: Paraphrase and summarize a cactus passage
classroom.description: Practise keeping the meaning when you change or shorten a sentence.
